About our TV media walls

Most TV walls fail in the same places: the screen sits too high, the cabinet is too shallow for the receiver, and the cables end up in a surface raceway anyway. Our builds start from measurements - of the wall, the equipment and the seating - and the design preview shows the composition before a single panel is ordered. Framing, backing, finish, cabinetry and lighting go up in planned layers, with flush access panels where you will need them in three years, not just on day one.

Materials we work with

  • acoustic wood slat panels
  • large-format porcelain or marble-look tile
  • matte lacquer panels
  • floating cabinets with soft-close hardware
  • concealed cable channels and ventilation

Popular options

  • screens and projectors from 55in to 120in
  • motorized projector platforms and lift trays
  • floating or full-height built-in cabinets
  • LED backlighting on dimmers and remotes
  • hidden doors and flush access panels

What's included

  • Design preview from your photo
  • Written fixed estimate
  • Framing and panel installation
  • TV mounting and concealed cables
  • LED lighting setup where selected
  • Paint/finish and final cleanup

How it works

STEP 1 - CONCEPT

It starts with one photo of your room. From it we build the design concept, check equipment fit, and send you the concept with a written estimate range.

STEP 2 - APPROVAL

You approve the concept and choose final materials. We then fix the itemized estimate and book the build days - no work begins before the number is agreed.

STEP 3 - INSTALLATION

Materials arrive prepared. We protect floors and furniture, build the wall layer by layer, and leave the room clean at the end of each day.

STEP 4 - HANDOVER

We mount and connect equipment, set up lighting and remotes with you, and inspect every edge together. Only then is the project closed out.

Common questions

How much does a TV media wall cost in Los Angeles?

A full custom TV media wall in Los Angeles starts at $7,500. Most finished projects land between $8,000 and $14,000 depending on wall width, materials and cabinetry. You get a written estimate with the full scope before any work starts, and the price in the estimate is the price you pay.

How long does a media wall installation take in Los Angeles?

Most media walls in Los Angeles take 3 to 5 working days on site once materials are ready. Design, ordering and fabrication happen before that, so your living room is only a work zone for the build days themselves.

Can you hide all the wires and equipment?

Yes. Concealed channels, ventilated equipment bays and flush access panels are part of the standard design. Consoles, routers and soundbars stay reachable but invisible.
